note: 人工补录条目（进 git）。覆盖权最高：同 id 覆盖 builder 生成件——id 约定与生成件一致（蓝筹 b:<小写地址>，准蓝筹 q:<小写地址>，如 b:0x1234…abcd 覆盖 bluechips.json 同地址条目），用于蓝筹掉榜兜底（如知名 meme 掉出 GMGN 榜单后仍需在库）。字段与 bluechips/quasi 同构；地址必须查实后录入，勿用示意地址。

entries.name: 熊猫头
entries.narrative: 熊猫头 is the legendary meme that dominated Chinese internet culture for over 15 years, now immortalized on BSC. Born from a 2010 Egyptian cheese commercial and remixed by Chinese netizens into thousands of viral expressions, Panda Head became the ultimate weapon in online "meme battles" — the Pepe of the East.…
